title: cleisostoma flagellare
intro: Cleisostoma flagellare, commonly known as the whip orchid, is a species of orchid native to Southeast Asia. It is a plant used in traditional medicine, known for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to reduce stress and promote relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Cleisostoma flagellare include sedative and antispasmodic effects, making it useful for treating anxiety and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
